topic: Topuria back to training: the comeback, Paddy and the lightweight picture
context: VERIFIED FACTS (only use these, never invent): Justin Gaethje beat Ilia Topuria at UFC Freedom 250 in June 2026 (the fight at the White House); it was Topuria's first pro loss, he had been an undefeated two-division UFC champion. This week Topuria shared new training footage on social media ('back to the office'): he is back in the gym. Gaethje is the UFC lightweight champion, says he will not fight again this year and refuses a Topuria rematch. Arman Tsarukyan knocked out Mauricio Ruffy at UFC 331 in September and is the No. 1 lightweight contender. Paddy Pimblett lost to Gaethje before, keeps calling for a Topuria fight and pitched coaching The Ultimate Fighter opposite him. No Topuria comeback fight is booked. Topic of the video: Topuria returns to training, who he should fight next (Paddy, a gradual comeback, the rematch), and how the lightweight picture looks with Gaethje and Arman.
